verdict.rationale: Pulumi runs its own public Registry listing 316 packages, including AWS, Azure Native, Google Cloud and Kubernetes. Every supported language can consume the full surface of Registry providers, and the Registry invites users to 'Contribute your own packages,' so both consuming and publishing are covered. The publishing workflow is documented only by a single line, and reusable components (as distinct from providers) are only implied by the AWSx mention. Missing for 10: detailed docs on how packages or components are authored and published to the Registry, explicit documentation of component/module packages beyond providers, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can consume and publish reusable modules or components from a public registry

citations.quote: Featured packages ... AWS ... Azure Native ... Google Cloud ... Kubernetes ... Packages 316
Each language is equally capable and supports the full surface area of all Pulumi Registry providers.
